cases.procedure: Import every declared Foundation module from a downstream crate; add a separate negative consumer with an unsafe block in a member inheriting workspace lints.
cases.expected: All declared imports resolve; negative member is rejected by unsafe_code before execution.

cases.procedure: Pass Ok(7) and each enumerated FoundationError through a function returning the Result alias.
cases.expected: Ok remains 7; every error variant and stable code is preserved.

cases.procedure: Import every documented prelude export individually; in separate negative fixtures import prelude::CancellationSource and prelude::Uuid.
cases.expected: Named exports compile; each negative import fails to resolve its intended symbol.

cases.procedure: Import generation, identifier and namespace from a downstream crate; try a struct literal for Identifier containing valid typed fields.
cases.expected: All modules import; downstream construction fails specifically because fields are private.

cases.procedure: Parse api.v1 at 6 bytes, api.v1 at 5 bytes, api. at 4 bytes, A at 1 byte and empty input at zero bytes.
cases.expected: Return api.v1, LimitExceeded, InvalidIdentifier, InvalidIdentifier and InvalidIdentifier respectively.

cases.procedure: Inject counting UUID sources returning one nonnil UUID, one nil UUID and a typed source error. Request IdKind::Device each time.
cases.expected: Exactly one source call; valid output is Device with original bytes, nil returns NilIdentifier, error is unchanged.

cases.procedure: In a downstream fixture import each published types module with no daemon or provider configured.
cases.expected: All imports resolve without using any daemon, provider or background process.

cases.procedure: Construct (-1,999999999), (-62135596800,0), (253402300799,999999999), and test seconds outside both endpoints and 1000000000 fractional ns. Encode and read each valid UTC form.
cases.expected: Exact round trips for valid values, LimitExceeded for each invalid input, and valid forms include nine fractional digits and Z.

cases.procedure: Construct 0, 9007199254740993 and u64::MAX milliseconds; add 1 to max and encode at JSON boundary.
cases.expected: Zero duration is accepted, decimal strings preserve full precision, and max + 1 returns QuantityOverflow.
First two succeed, third overflows, last three fail grammar, and 1.9.9 orders before 2.0.0.

cases.procedure: Build distinct Bytes and Tokens quantity markers and attempt mixed addition. In a positive fixture add Bytes(3) and Bytes(4) and overflow Bytes(u64::MAX) plus 1.
cases.expected: Mixed units fail type checking; pure same-unit results are 7 and QuantityOverflow respectively.

cases.procedure: Copy [0,255] with limit 2, then repeat with limit 1; copy empty input with limit 0 and observe a scoped allocation probe.
cases.expected: First/last produce exact copies, denial makes no allocation attempt, and borrowed/consumed bytes agree.

cases.procedure: Import capability, compatibility, component and lifecycle under the minimal Foundation profile.
cases.expected: All four paths resolve without daemon features.

cases.procedure: Construct descriptor using a live namespace and capability slice; in a negative fixture return descriptor borrowing a local namespace.
cases.expected: Positive construction succeeds; return of the local borrow is rejected.

cases.procedure: Offer artifact.read 1.2.1; request same ID at 1.1.99, 1.2.9, 1.3.0 and 2.0.0, plus artifact.write 1.1.0.
cases.expected: Results are true, true, false, false, false in that order. No approval is issued.

cases.procedure: Evaluate is_terminal on Created, Ready, Running, Draining, Stopped and Failed.
cases.expected: Only Stopped and Failed return true; the fixture does not assert cleanup from phase alone.

cases.procedure: Negotiate 1.4.9 with 1.2.0 in both orders, then 1.4.9 with 2.4.9. Request a minor-3-only feature using agreed minor 2 in adapter fixture.
cases.expected: Both compatible orders yield (1,2); major mismatch yields None and required feature is denied.

cases.procedure: Import constraints and invariant; attempt a downstream U64Range literal with inverted bounds in isolated negative fixture.
cases.expected: Both module imports resolve and a direct literal is rejected as private.

cases.procedure: Try range 8..=7, check range 7..=7 against 6,7,8, and check u64::MAX..=u64::MAX with the maximum.
cases.expected: Inverted bounds fail; singleton rejects 6 and 8, accepts 7; max singleton passes.

cases.procedure: Call require(true,e) and require(false,e) for each FoundationError variant.
cases.expected: True returns Ok(()); false returns exactly e with no I/O or retry.

cases.procedure: Encode two records for same source/digest observed at seconds 0 and 1; in receiving adapter verify against a different digest.
cases.expected: Both timestamps and typed source round-trip; different candidate digest fails verification.

cases.procedure: Enumerate FoundationError variants in documented order and capture code and Display for each.
cases.expected: Each code equals documented lower-snake-case spelling and Display contains that code only.

cases.procedure: Check Send + Sync using a generic trait-bound helper, and compare identical and different FoundationError variants in a positive test.
cases.expected: All traits resolve and equality matches variant identity.

cases.procedure: Send malformed identifier and digest strings including synthetic value CANDIDATE_CANARY; capture returned Display values.
cases.expected: Stable error strings contain neither rejected payload nor the canary.

cases.procedure: Parse f085e513-c740-416b-d33d-26758ead6d0c as Repository, compare UUID bytes, format canonical spelling and parse again.
cases.expected: Kind, bytes and exact spelling match across both parses.

cases.procedure: Give uppercase, missing hyphen, trailing text and canonical all-zero UUID.
cases.expected: First three return InvalidIdentifier; all-zero returns NilIdentifier.

cases.procedure: Construct Repository and Workspace using the same UUID; put them in equality-keyed set.
cases.expected: Values unequal; set has two entries regardless of whether hash values collide.

cases.procedure: Run approved seeded byte mutation over canonical UUID corpus including arbitrary UTF-8 and invalid raw UTF-8 at adapter boundary.
cases.expected: No panic; accepted value is canonical and nonnil. Invalid raw UTF-8 does not reach the str parser.

cases.procedure: Parse sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 and write tagged bytes.
cases.expected: Exactly 71 canonical bytes and correct 32-byte digest.

cases.procedure: For canonical sha256 tag, supply uppercase payload, short payload, long payload and extra colon.
cases.expected: All return InvalidDigestEncoding.

cases.procedure: Give sha999 tag with canonical hex and separately an empty payload, whitespace and multi-colon framing.
cases.expected: Valid unknown tag is UnsupportedDigestAlgorithm; malformed framing is InvalidDigestEncoding.

cases.procedure: Generate arbitrary 32-byte values from pinned seed, write into fixed output and read back; inject malformed strings.
cases.expected: Round trips equal, no panic, parser and writer do not allocate.

cases.procedure: Check zero demand against Limit(0), charge 3 against bound 3, then charge 1; compare same run with configured bound 4.
cases.expected: Initial equality succeeds, extra charge against 3 fails atomically, and the same additional charge against 4 succeeds.

cases.procedure: Start usage at u64::MAX under bound u64::MAX and charge 1; repeat at 3 under bound 3.
cases.expected: First fails QuantityOverflow, second LimitExceeded, and prior usage is retained.

cases.procedure: Generate lease bound and monotonic charges with a pinned seed; compare accepted cumulative total and typed rejection against checked integer reference.
cases.expected: Success agrees with inclusive checked sum and each error leaves state unchanged.

cases.procedure: Schedule cancel before first poll and first poll before cancel using directed barriers and separate active wakers. Repoll after each schedule.
cases.expected: Both end Ready(Ok); only already registered waiter receives a wake, with no lost notification.

cases.procedure: Reserve two waiters, drop first while Pending, register replacement, then cancel.
cases.expected: Only remaining waiter and replacement wake, each once. Capacity recovered before cancel.

cases.procedure: Race two calls to cancel with synchronized starting barrier, then invoke a third time.
cases.expected: Exactly one true and two false; registered waiters each wake once.

cases.procedure: At zero capacity poll an uncancelled token, cancel and create a new wait. At finite capacity repoll with a new waker and cancel. In a separate run drop the last waiter before cancellation.
cases.expected: First result ObserverLimit stays fused, new wait is ready successful, only the replacement waker fires after repoll, and dropping the last waiter leaves no wake.

cases.procedure: Use Waker implementing safe std::task::Wake whose callback re-enters is_cancelled, and a displaced waker whose drop re-enters observation.
cases.expected: Test completes under harness deadline and observes sticky cancellation without waiting on held mutex.
